milestone: Dev Graph milestone 1, ticket 'Dev-graph schema and snapshot builder on a synthetic fixture' (tickets.md and .scratch/dev-graph-milestone-1/PRD.md)
authority: CLAUDE.md §9.4 (durable recording of a decision that affects future interpretation), §5 Tier 3 (project facts have one authoritative source), §17.5.3 (deterministic components). Not a constitutional amendment.
decision: Every field the dev graph indexes has exactly one writer, and the graph is never that writer. The graph is a rebuildable index over authoritative records. It can be deleted and rebuilt at any time without loss.

project facts (participants, objectives,.owner: Tier 3 JSON under docs/tier3_project_instantiation/ (partners.json, objectives.json, workpackage_seed.json, milestones_seed.json)
project facts (participants, objectives,.graph_role: index only. Node id comes from the record's declared key and version from the record's content hash.

typed relationships.owner: derived by the builder from record structure (lead_partner, responsible_partner, contributing_partners, dependencies, objectives, produced_by, task and deliverable membership, milestone deliverables)
typed relationships.graph_role: the edge set is the only thing the graph adds. It is recomputed on every build and never stored back into Tier 3. Tier 3 declares no predicate of its own, so it stays the single writer of each fact.

node identity.owner: the record's declared key field (partner_id, objective_id, wp_id, task_id, deliverable_id, milestone_id)
node identity.graph_role: id is separate from file path and title. Renaming a file or a title changes the version, never the id.

node version.owner: computed by the builder as sha256 over canonical JSON of the record
node version.graph_role: a node reference is always id plus version

snapshot id.owner: computed by the builder as sha256 over canonical JSON of the sorted nodes and edges, recursively, with no wall-clock field
snapshot id.graph_role: the identity a package or an assessment names when it says which graph it used

generated wording (Tier 5 sections).owner: Tier 5 section artifacts (unchanged by this ticket)
generated wording (Tier 5 sections).graph_role: not indexed yet. Passage nodes arrive with the document-snapshot ticket.

run and gate outcomes (Tier 4).graph_role: not indexed yet. Execution nodes arrive with the impact planner ticket.

instrument constraints (Tier 2A).graph_role: not indexed by this ticket. The fixture holds a synthetic entry for the profile and policy tickets.

consequences: The snapshot writer (deterministic component dev_graph_snapshot_writer) writes only docs/tier4_orchestration_state/dev_graph/snapshot.json. It writes nothing under Tier 3.
No Tier 3 file is modified by the builder. A build is a pure read.
The existing whole-Tier-3 reuse fingerprint, the scheduler, the gate evaluator and the gate library are untouched.
verification: tests/runner/test_dev_graph_snapshot.py: identity separate from path and title, edges reference id plus version, byte-equal replay through the component registry, and an explicit empty snapshot for an empty Tier 3.
